title: Janumada Jodi
desc: A lovelorn village boy, Krishna, and a girl, Kanaka, cross all barriers of caste and tradition to unite in a meaningful manner.

title: Namma Kutumba
desc: A six-year-old boy loses his parents in a car accident prior to their divorce. However, 30 years later, he comes across two youngsters who resemble them and decides to unite them.

title: Maragatha Mani
desc: Two thieves take on an audacious task to acquire an antique emerald medallion. In their pursuit, they seek the help of a priest to protect them from an ancient curse.

title: Thandege Thakka Maga
desc: Sathya is forced to marry a woman from a lower caste after his father's sudden death. He struggles to lead a happy marital life while dealing with certain problems.
